headline: Chile Industrial Output Falls 2.7% in September Despite Factory Gain
summary: Chile's factory output rose 2% in September, but an 8.7% drop in mining output dragged total industrial production down 2.7% year-on-year, statistics agency INE reported.
why: Chile is the world's top copper producer, meaning its mining production data serves as an indicator for global base-metal supply and economic growth in Latin America.
